retention.title: Chat retention
retention.help: Chats with no activity for longer than this are deleted by the daily job, with their messages, shared links and search entries, and the files attached only to them. This is permanent and cannot be undone. Files that can't safely be tied to one chat stay until someone deletes them.
retention.range: Between 1 and 120 months. The default is 12.
retention.confirmShorter: Everyone in the company is emailed first. 30 days after that email has gone, chats with no activity for {{months}} months start to be deleted permanently. Until then the current period stays in force. This cannot be undone. Continue?
retention.readOnly: Only the company's own admins can change this.
retention.notStarted: No chats are being deleted yet. Everyone in the company is emailed first, and deletion starts 30 days after that email has gone.
retention.inEffect: Chats with no activity for {{months}} months are being deleted.
retention.sending: A notice is going out to everyone in the company. Deletion starts 30 days after it has gone, and not before.
retention.sendingWhile: Chats still go after {{inForce}} months. A notice is going out to everyone about {{notice}} months, which starts 30 days after it has gone.
retention.starts: Everyone has been emailed. From {{date}}, chats with no activity for {{months}} months will be deleted.
retention.startsWhile: Everyone has been emailed. Chats go after {{inForce}} months until {{date}}, then after {{months}} months.
